properties.note: 2026-11-16 automatic rule: (1) mountain foot = strongest concave slope break near the mountain-mask edge (DEM smoothed 300 m), Viterbi; (2) side-valley mouths where the foot recedes >4 km beyond the local valley width are closed by a straight line; (3) flat low plains outside the line are added back
